lead: Real photos of the whole Earth, taken by a NASA camera 1.5 million km away.
try: Press Spin the day to watch Earth turn, then Show me India.
points: The camera always faces the sunny side of Earth, so every photo shows a fully lit Earth.
Earth turns 15 degrees every hour, so each photo shows a different part of the world.
The white swirls are clouds. Deserts are brown, oceans blue and forests dark green.
